title: Chestnut Square Historic Village

services.name: Trolley Tour
services.desc: All aboard! Join us for a charming one-hour trolley tour through the heart of McKinney's Historic District, where history meets hospitality. Sit back, relax, and enjoy a narrated journey past some of the city’s most iconic and beautifully preserved homes. From McKinney’s historic buildings that showcase our rich heritage to grand Victorian residences full of character, you'll discover the unique architectural styles and fascinating stories that have shaped McKinney into one of Texas’s most beloved historic towns. Whether you're a history buff, architecture enthusiast, or simply looking for a scenic and relaxing way to explore, this tour offers a delightful glimpse into McKinney's rich past
